name: alphaxiv_papers
description: Natural-language alphaXiv downloader. Pass a search query, a paper URL, or a trending keyword via --query (or state.query); the op discovers /abs/<id> papers, renders each one until its SPA settles, and writes Markdown plus figures under out_dir (default ~/tmp/alphaxiv). Paper pages are fetched in Chinese by default (lang defaults to zh; set lang to en/off to disable). Trending saves 10 by default and pages through alphaXiv's feed API, so count can reach 500 (e.g. --state '{"count":100,"interval":"30 Days"}'). Optional state: mode (auto|search|trending|url), count, interval (3 Days|7 Days|30 Days|90 Days|All time), paper_url, out_dir, selector, lang. Each <slug>_meta.json records a UTC downloaded_at (plus trending rank/interval) for monitoring.
